news.headline: AfterQuery reportedly becomes Y Combinator’s fastest-ever unicorn, now valued at $3.2B
news.summary: AfterQuery's valuation skyrocketed from $300M to $3.2B in five months, making it Y Combinator's fastest unicorn ever. The AI model-training startup's explosive growth caps a remarkable sprint from Series A to unicorn status.

news.headline: Nepal’s mountain tourism industry faces ‘serious warning’ after Himalayan flood disaster
news.summary: Nepal's devastating floods are casting a shadow over its adventure tourism sector right before peak season hits. The disaster has triggered fresh concerns about the industry's resilience and recovery timeline—a critical economic lifeline for the mountain nation.

educational.title: Machine Learning vs. AI vs. LLMs — What's the Difference?
points: AI is the broad goal: machines performing tasks that normally need human intelligence
Machine learning is one method — systems that improve from data instead of fixed rules
Deep learning is a subset of ML using layered neural networks
LLMs (like the ones powering chatbots) are deep learning models trained on huge text data
Not all AI is an LLM, and not all machine learning involves neural networks
